text: We went there and asked which package we needed to have the interior of our new car cleaned—not shampooed, just the seats sprayed and wiped down. We were told to get the $39.00 VIP package, which would include cleaning the front and back seats. Not only did the exterior wash look horrible, but they barely wiped down the front seats, doors, and dash, and they didn’t wipe anything in the back. I had to argue with the manager for almost 10 minutes about wiping down the back, which took him all of two minutes to do, and it was still so half-hearted that I had to do it myself once I got the car home.
